mapper.select: SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.CREATE_DATE AS create_date, T.enabled, R.AUTHORITY, R.alias, R.tenant_id, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias, OL.IS_ONLINE, OL.OFFLINE_TIME, TC.NICKNAME CREATOR, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.USERNAME,T1.authority, T2.alias, T2.tenant_id FROM LA_USER_ROLES T1 INNER JOIN LA_ROLES T2 ON t2.AUTHORITY = T1.authority AND T2.enabled = 1) R ON R.USERNAME = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.USERNAME LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.ORGANIZATION_ID LEFT JOIN la_user_online_logs OL ON T.USERNAME = OL.USERNAME LEFT JOIN LA_USERS TC ON T.CREATOR = TC.USERNAME WHERE T.username IN #{user.username} ORDER BY T.CREATE_DATE DESC, T.USERNAME

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.CREATE_DATE AS create_date, T.enabled, R.authority, R.alias, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES U ON U.USERNAME = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = U.authority LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.USERNAME LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND (T.username LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%') OR T.nickname LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%') OR T.mobile LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%') OR T.email LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%'))
ORDER BY T.USERNAME

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.CREATE_DATE AS create_date, T.enabled, T.TENANT_ID, R.authority, R.alias, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.USERNAME = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.USERNAME LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.ORGANIZATION_ID WHERE T.username = #{username}
SELECT T.username, T.password FROM LA_USERS T WHERE T.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LA_USERS (USERNAME, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, MOBILE, EMAIL, CREATE_DATE, ENABLED, TENANT_ID, CREATOR, EXPIRED_TIME) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{mobile,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 1, #{tenant_Id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creator, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiredTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LA_USERS T WHERE T.USERNAME = #{username})
mapper.update: UPDATE LA_USERS SET password = #{password} where username = #{username}
UPDATE LA_USERS SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.CREATE_DATE AS create_date, T.enabled, R.authority, R.alias, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES U ON U.USERNAME = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = U.authority LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.USERNAME LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.ORGANIZATION_ID WHERE UO.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgId}

AND T1.ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.RESOURCE_ID FROM LA_ROLE_RESOURCES T WHERE T.AUTHORITY IN #{item} )
AND T1.res_mode = #{mode}
ORDER BY T1.RES_LEVEL, T1.parent_id, T1.orderno
